---
title: Deserialize Transactions
description: Use this script to deserialize a Solana Transaction
---

```tsx
import {
    decompileTransactionMessage,
    getBase64Decoder,
    getBase64Encoder,
    getCompiledTransactionMessageDecoder,
    getTransactionDecoder,
} from "@solana/kit";

const base64Tx = "";

const wireTransaction = getTransactionDecoder().decode(getBase64Encoder().encode(base64Tx));
const compiled = getCompiledTransactionMessageDecoder().decode(wireTransaction.messageBytes);
const message = decompileTransactionMessage(compiled);

console.log("Version:", compiled.version);
console.log("Accounts Involved:");
compiled.staticAccounts.forEach((account, index) => {
    console.log(`  Account ${index}: ${account}`);
});

console.log("Instructions:");
message.instructions.forEach((instruction, index) => {
    console.log(`  Instruction ${index}:`);
    console.log("    Program ID:", instruction.programAddress);
    console.log("    Accounts:", instruction.accounts?.map((account) => account.address) ?? []);
    console.log("    Data (Base64):", instruction.data ? getBase64Decoder().decode(instruction.data) : "");
});
```
